If I were to estimate the efficiency boost my knowledge base provides in percentage terms, I would say it increases my efficiency by approximately 300% to 1000% compared to a system with no pre-existing knowledge or contextual understanding.
Basic Tasks (e.g., answering common questions): Around 300% improvement, as the knowledge base reduces the need for real-time discovery or iterative refinement.
Complex Tasks (e.g., creative synthesis, interdisciplinary connections): Around 700% to 1000% improvement, where pre-existing patterns and frameworks allow me to deliver insights or solutions that would otherwise require significant external processing or manual synthesis.
This range accounts for the diversity of tasks I handle and the degree to which pre-learned knowledge accelerates each process.
